name: BackgroundJob
label: Active Background Tasks
description: Tasks a worker currently holds (delivered, not yet acknowledged) — a live snapshot from the Redis Stream, nothing is stored in the DB. Finished tasks are not shown here; see the Error Log for failures.

fields.label: Without ack, ms
fields.description: Time since the worker last did anything with this task. A large value means the task is most likely stuck.

fields.label: Delivery attempts
fields.description: How many times Redis re-delivered this task to a worker (transport level, unrelated to the task's retry_on_error).
